work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CCXVI 65829, synopsis 65832–65835, royal addressee 65837–65838 and self-protocol 65840 open the independent papal indult. Full exposition and petition 65845–65940 lead to concession/absolution 65942–65969 and complete §§5–8 through 66032. Full/short dating 66034–66038 closes before CCXVII 66041. Current notes 65925,65927,65985 and delayed 66051 have explicit current wording anchors (66004 for the missing adimplere); include the last note disjointly while excluding CCXVII and its source note 66053. Literal reported formula omissions are unexpanded.
